The '''Genarius Jedi Enclave''' was a [[Jedi Enclaves|Jedi enclave]] that was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Tolea Biqua]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]].

The enclave was purged by the [[Bane Brigade]] during the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[Battle of Genarius (Great Galactic War)|assault]] on the world during the [[Great Galactic War]].

During the [[SoroSuub Anniversary celebration, 31 BBY|SoroSuub Anniversary celebration]] in Tolea Biqua in [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], a number of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] gathered at the enclave.
